exposure: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidance on the antenatal management of uncomplicated twin pregnancies
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 1666 twin pregnancies delivered at St George's Hospital, London, UK, between 2000 and 2018
finding: Implementation of the NICE guidance on the antenatal management of uncomplicated twin pregnancies was associated with a significant reduction in the stillbirth rate.
